description: This file defines a Spring configuration class that creates and configures a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor for handling external events asynchronously within the Apache Fineract infrastructure. It uses properties from FineractProperties to set thread pool sizes and queue capacities.

classes.name: EventTaskExecutorConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines a bean for a thread pool executor to handle external event processing asynchronously.

methods.name: sendAsynchronousEventsThreadPool
methods.description: Creates and initializes a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor configured with sizes and queue capacity from application properties.
